guidance: This style requires `input_image`; `reference_images` do not replace it.
Use `input_image` for the main image being edited, animated, varied, or used as the required starting frame.
Use `reference_images` for extra per-inference guidance images only when the selected public style supports them.
Use `style_reference_images` only on create_user_style or update_user_style when defining a custom style.
This style does not support per-inference `reference_images`.
